speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are at the Keys. I cannot hear a word of it. I do not want a report when it is over.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The morning is the loss. I had a page, and I could not tell the good line from the bad.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fever may have the afternoon. It already had the work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Rose has a Caesar. I am not going. …No.
